verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm. Its Tech Studio is a free, self-service library of forms, document generators, articles and health-check tools, so user-configurable background automations are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Orrick ships any automation, scheduling, or autonomous-agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
